description: Environment setup - install dependencies, verify build and tests pass on baseline
steps: Run `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 && npm ci` to install all dependencies
Run `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 && npm run build` to verify TypeScript compiles cleanly
Run `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 && npx vitest run` to verify existing tests pass
acceptance_criteria: npm run build compiles without TypeScript errors
verification: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 && npm run build
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 && npx vitest run
findings: npm ci completed with deprecation warnings (rimraf, glob, uuid) and 4 moderate vulnerabilities but no errors. TypeScript compiles cleanly. All 253 tests pass across 17 test files in 12.6s. Node v24.15.0 with npm 11.4.2. better-sqlite3 compiled successfully via prebuild.
